message.content: During the 19th century, one of the most celebrated sculptures was **“The Kiss” (Le Baiser) by Auguste Rodin** (completed in 1889). It became an icon of Romanticism and modern art, widely reproduced and admired worldwide. Another landmark piece from that era was **“The Gates of Hell” (Les Portes de l’Enfer)**, also by Rodin, begun in 1880 and completed in 1917; its monumental scale and dramatic figures made it a defining work of late‑Victorian sculpture.
